fusions.name: Thrown from Nowhere
fusions.desc: Throws a knife that deals 34 damage to the first enemy it meets and always crits, leaving it [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds and [Marked] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Edge Count
fusions.desc: A thrown knife that deals 6 damage, up to 1.5 times that at its maximum reach of 7 tiles. Its damage rises 10% for each affliction on the target (max 30%). Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Slip Behind
fusions.desc: Steps you instantly to a point up to 5 tiles away. Using it increases your movement speed by 20% for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Second Edge
fusions.desc: Once every 10 seconds, a strike that failed to crit is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
